Definition: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
BiblicalUsage: Abram pitches his tent between Bethel and Hai and calls on the name of the LORD, and Moses stretches his hand over the sea so that the waters part. The LORD stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and the psalm calls on Him to bow the heavens and come down.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe stretching out is what God does with everything He owns: His hand over the sea, His heavens over the earth, and His tent over His people. When He stretches out His hand, something moves — sea, sky, or heart.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
